title: Series to explore practice of citizenship
summary_en: Presented by the WashU John C. Danforth Center on Religion and Politics. “The Practice of Citizenship” series invites participants to think critically about what it means to be a citizen.
title_cn: Series to explore practice of citizenship

title: WashU Arboretum holds free tours and events
summary_en: WashU has launched free public tours of its nationally recognized arboretum, showcasing iconic trees, fall colors and campus biodiversity. WashU is among the rare college campuses to host a Level III arboretum and botanic garden.
title_cn: WashU Arboretum holds free tours and events

title: $11.7 million from NIH supports research on inflammation in blood cancers
summary_en: A grant to WashU Medicine researchers will fund the study of how inflammation drives myeloproliferative neoplasms, a group of blood cancers at high risk of progressing to acute myeloid leukemia.
title_cn: $11.7 million from NIH supports research on inflammation in blood cancers

title: Blocking immune cells’ path into brain limits neurodegeneration
summary_en: In a mouse study, WashU Medicine researchers show that a drug injected into the body can reduce damage caused by a protein called tau, which accumulates in the brain in Alzheimer’s and related neurological diseases.
title_cn: Blocking immune cells’ path into brain limits neurodegeneration
